regions.evidence: Header-bounded CHR ROM hardware pattern storage: 16384 16-byte 2bpp tiles, separated from CPU PRG. Tile pattern structure and rendered game frame confirm graphics role; no CPU execution view. Subdivision by graphic use deferred.

regions.label: PackedPcmSample0
regions.evidence: Packed 4-bit DAC sample record. Direct bank14 callsites independently encode all eight starts; each has delay40/countLE16, stored record size count+3 and adjacent anchored next start. Consumer file0x1EE1C reads delay/count, initializes playback pointer to header+2 (including count-high byte), emits exactly count low/high nibble pairs to $4011, and leaves one stored trailing byte. This implementation detail does not imply count+3 bytes are all played. First seven record ends equal next direct-call start; final end0x4EA9 separates recurring sample nibble pattern from AD0203 code-like content. Generic non-code role of trailing stored byte is supported; exact original sample generator and spoken phrases unresolved. See investigation correction and r001/voice-decoder.json.

regions.label: PlayPackedPcm
regions.evidence: Supported direct callers set A=MMC3 sample bank and $04/$05=header pointer. Routine banks A000 window via $ED9B, saves header delay/count in cartridge RAM $6FE7..9, plays low/high nibbles to $4011, advances pointer with bank wrap, decrements exact byte count, restores IRQ/PPU state and returns. Static contract and full loop/return consistency; natural execution not asserted. See voice-decoder.json and static-1ee1c.json.

regions.label: SpeakCountEvents
regions.evidence: Baseball callsite logic reads $6C32/$6C1A, initializes sample pointer and bank immediate before direct PlayPackedPcm calls; bounded paths end RTS before inline bytes0x1C942. Decoded in voice-callers.json; structural code, natural state reachability not established.

Every encoded count independently aligns next team header or the end of roster sequence; all player names validate. Baltimore first nine names and pitcher choice match observed lineup frame analysis/r001/lineup.ppm. Exact field meanings partly unresolved; structural data role and bounds supported by repeated layouts/encoded counts. See analysis/r001/rosters.json.
